assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production asset for Bannerlands isometric fantasy medieval RTS. Hand-painted realistic miniature game sprites with crisp silhouettes, natural detailed materials, gentle warm upper-left lighting, isometric 3/4 perspective matching classic Age of Empires painted unit art. Genuine transparent background. No text, no labels, no grid lines, no frame borders. Every object fully inside its cell, at least 12% padding on each side, same ground baseline and consistent scale across frames. Do not paint checkerboard. Square sprite sheet EXACTLY 2 columns and 2 rows equal cells, four separate castles. Top-left a neutral ruined castle: broken gray stone towers, collapsed gate and walls, ivy and scattered rubble, no flags. Top-right the same footprint completely rebuilt as a small stone castle with battlements and wooden central hall, subdued neutral banner cloth ready to tint. Bottom-left a more damaged variant of the ruined castle with broken arch and rubble. Bottom-right alternate restored castle on same footprint, small stone keep with complete towers. All face front-right isometrically, ground contact centered. Buildings fill about 72% of each cell, no ground tile base beyond tiny attached rubble.
